passages.provision_quote: Marriage between two individuals shall not be prohibited or void on the basis of the sex, race, ethnicity or national origin of those individuals.
passages.note: Co-sponsored House concurrent resolution securing the right to marry with no anti-discrimination clause; earlier House term, same legislature.

passages.provision_quote: Marriage between two individuals shall not be prohibited or void on the basis of the sex, race, ethnicity or national origin of those individuals.
passages.note: Co-sponsored Senate concurrent resolution with the same operative text, in the current Senate term.

rows.reasoning: Ortiz co-sponsored HCR 2017 (2024) and SCR 1024 (2025), each proposing that marriage between two individuals not be prohibited or void on the basis of sex, which secures same-sex marriage in the constitution. That matches "Guarantee same-sex marriage the same benefits and protections as any other marriage"; neither measure has an anti-discrimination clause, so it is not the full-equality rung, and neither has a religious carve-out.
